title: The Leviathan

panels.shot: Exterior, night. The sea wall. The aquarium's whale-shaped facade, dark; the sign THE LEVIATHAN - VALMORA CITY AQUARIUM with half its neon dead. Storm waves smash over the wall in white spray. Mags's old green coupe, headlights off, wipers moving.

lines.text: The Leviathan. Kids come here by day. Contraband by night.

panels.shot: Interior of the car, close. Mags lights a cigarette; the match lights both faces. Rain runs down the windscreen. Nero's head between the seats from the back.

lines.speaker: Mags
lines.text: I'll keep the engine warm. Don't make me come in after you.

panels.shot: Medium. Elias at the staff door, the lock already broken. He looks back once at the car. Nero's nose at the car's window.

lines.text: The dog obeyed. He always does when it matters.

panels.shot: Wide. The hero in the blue glass tunnel. A shark passes overhead, its shadow sliding across his face.

lines.text: Glass between me and the teeth. Same as every night of my life.

panels.shot: Medium. Divers in black wetsuits load crates onto a boat at a basement dock. One raises a harpoon gun toward the camera.
